pixelforge.name: PixelForge
pixelforge.about: Variety gaming, mostly roguelikes and whatever chat votes for on Fridays. Live weekdays 7pm PT.

speedrun-sam.name: Speedrun Sam
speedrun-sam.about: Any% and 100% runs of Hollow Cartographer and Glass Citadel. Current WR holder in two categories.

lofi-lena.name: Lofi Lena
lofi-lena.about: Live beats, live loops, live mistakes. Ambient sets every evening.

inkwell-art.name: Inkwell
inkwell-art.about: Digital painting streams. Commissions open, chat picks the palette.

deploy-dan.name: Deploy Dan
deploy-dan.about: Building a game engine in Rust live on stream. Compiler errors included.

tabletop-tuesday.name: Tabletop Tuesday
tabletop-tuesday.about: A weekly tabletop campaign with five players and one increasingly nervous game master.

pixelforge-live-roguelike.title: LIVE: Friday roguelike marathon, chat picks the seed
pixelforge-live-roguelike.description: Six hours, one run per seed, no restarts. Redeem channel points to pick the next one.

comments.author: speedrun-sam
comments.text: that dodge at 2:14:00 was frame perfect, get on the leaderboard

pixelforge-vod-glass.title: VOD: Glass Citadel blind playthrough, part 3
pixelforge-vod-glass.description: Third session of the blind run. We find the second bell tower and lose the whole party to it.

comments.author: tabletop-tuesday
comments.text: the bell tower fight is the best set piece this year

pixelforge-vod-chat-votes.title: VOD: Chat voted for a farming game and I am at peace
pixelforge-vod-chat-votes.description: A calm four hours. Nothing dies except the crops I forgot to water.

comments.author: lofi-lena
comments.text: I played this set over your stream and it fit perfectly

speedrun-sam-wr.title: VOD: Hollow Cartographer Any% world record, 41:07
speedrun-sam-wr.description: The run. Every skip lands, the map glitch at 18:30 saves eleven seconds, and the final split is by under a second.

comments.author: pixelforge
comments.text: I was watching live and screamed at the last split

comments.author: deploy-dan
comments.text: the map glitch is a float precision bug, I would know

speedrun-sam-live-100.title: LIVE: 100% attempts, Glass Citadel, sub 2:10 or bust
speedrun-sam-live-100.description: Grinding 100% attempts. Resetting anything over 32 minutes at the first bell tower.

speedrun-sam-tutorial.title: Tutorial: the Hollow Cartographer map glitch, frame by frame
speedrun-sam-tutorial.description: How the map clip works, why it only works at 60 fps, and the inputs to practise.

lofi-lena-live-evening.title: LIVE: evening loops, requests open
lofi-lena-live-evening.description: Ambient set until midnight. Drop a chord in chat and I will build a loop from it.

lofi-lena-vod-sunday.title: VOD: Sunday morning set (3 hours, no talking)
lofi-lena-vod-sunday.description: A slow set for slow mornings. Track list in the pinned comment.

lofi-lena-vod-rain.title: VOD: rain sounds and a broken sampler
lofi-lena-vod-rain.description: The sampler died forty minutes in. We kept going with the rain and a synth.

comments.author: deploy-dan
comments.text: the broken sampler section is the best part, please leave it

inkwell-live-commission.title: LIVE: commission stream, chat picks the palette
inkwell-live-commission.description: Painting a portrait commission from a sketch. Three palette polls, one every hour.

inkwell-vod-portrait.title: VOD: portrait study in three light sources
inkwell-vod-portrait.description: Same face, three lamps. Talking through why the shadows land where they do.

comments.author: tinyhistory-fan
comments.text: the third lamp section changed how I see faces

inkwell-vod-lighthouse.title: VOD: painting a lighthouse in a storm, start to finish
inkwell-vod-lighthouse.description: Six hours cut to four. The storm took the longest, the lighthouse took twenty minutes.

comments.author: pixelforge
comments.text: using this as a loading screen, with permission

deploy-dan-live-engine.title: LIVE: Rust game engine, day 41, the renderer finally draws a triangle
deploy-dan-live-engine.description: It is one triangle. It is the right colour. We are going to add a second one.

comments.author: speedrun-sam
comments.text: make it deterministic and I will speedrun it

deploy-dan-vod-physics.title: VOD: fixed-timestep physics, or why the jump felt wrong
deploy-dan-vod-physics.description: The jump height depended on frame rate. Two hours to find it, ten minutes to fix it.

comments.author: speedrun-sam
comments.text: THIS is why every speedrun category has a frame rate rule

tabletop-live-session.title: LIVE: Session 31, the party returns to the flooded archive
tabletop-live-session.description: Five players, one archive, a lot of water. The GM has prepared a map and is hoping nobody burns it.

comments.author: inkwell-art
comments.text: I painted the archive map for this, please do not burn it

tabletop-vod-session-30.title: VOD: Session 30, the party burns the map
tabletop-vod-session-30.description: They burned the map. The GM took a break. The break was streamed.
